text:
Maria G: heads-up — ran the accessibility audit on the new invite drawer. Two quick blockers: the role selector looks visually grouped but isn't announced as a list by screen readers, and the SSO toggle label is ambiguous. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123 (invite-drawer-compact) — can we align this before tomorrow's demo?

Kevin L: :eyes: good catches. For the role selector we can add `role="listbox"` and `aria-label="Select role"`. small CSS tweak for the pill focus outline should fix keyboard nav.

Jamal: I'd also prefer the SSO wording be softer — 'Require SSO for sign-in' over 'Force SSO'. the audit flagged the audit-log nav losing keyboard focus when switching orgs too.

Olivia S: updated mock with aria changes and helper text under the toggle. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def456 (invite-updates) — added a compact variant that reduces vertical spacing between role rows.

UIUX: spacing note — current density is too low for power users, but we need to keep 44px touch targets. propose collapsing permission descriptions into a hover/expander on desktop and always visible on mobile.

Maria G: tooltip-only descriptions could hide info from keyboard users. maybe show a short inline synopsis plus a 'more info' link that opens a small modal with full details.

Kevin L: implementation detail: modal must trap focus and return focus to the trigger btn. I'll add `data-focus-return` to the modal open path and verify with NVDA.

DesignBot: accessibility-lint: missing `aria-labelledby` on invite input; missing role on role pills; contrast warning on helper text color — report available at /reports/a11y/1968880000.

Jamal: also the invite copy is a bit wordy — current: 'Invite user and assign roles' -> suggestion: 'Invite user — assign role on first sign-in' (shorter, clearer).

Olivia S: :thumbsup: I like that. changing placeholder to 'Select a role (required)' helps form clarity too.

Maria G: plan: Kevin — push accessibility patch for rolelist + focus; Olivia — update figma + copy; Jamal — PR for audit-log focus fix. target EOD for the demo.

Kevin L: on it. will open PR today and run accessibility smoke tests. cc @design-reviewers

Olivia S: I'll post the updated screens here when uploaded.

Jamal: if anyone objects to 'Require SSO for sign-in' speak now, otherwise i'll sync the wording across invite / org settings / onboarding flows.

Maria G: :rocket: thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround.
